subject: EdgeSight discovery recap + timing check-in
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeSight discovery recap + next steps

Hi Olivia / Jordan —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and appreciate the context on where EdgeSight is headed for next quarter. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary (short):
- Use case: low-latency multi-tenant inference for anonymized diagnostics pipelines, ~20k daily requests currently, expected 3x growth.
- Constraints: SOC2 compliance, data retention 90 days, must be deployable to customer VPC (private deployment preferred).
- Success metric: reduce 95th percentile latency to <150ms and reduce inference cost per request by 30%.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share discovery notes and a short pricing snapshot (attached).
2) Can you confirm priority and timeline? You mentioned proof-of-concept in May — is that still the target?
3) If yes, propose a 30-45m technical sync with our solutions engineer (AvA Chen) to validate integration approach.

Requested action: please reply with preferred week for the POC kickoff (week of May 4 or May 11) or tell me if your timing shifted.

Attachments: edge-discovery-notes.pdf, pricing_snapshot.xlsx

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

I know schedules fill up — if May is still the goal, a brief confirmation would help us lock SE availability. If timing shifted, letting me know the new target month is perfect.

Two one-line options: 
- May POC: we block SE time and send a draft MOP (minimum operational plan).
- Later: we circle back in 4–6 weeks and I'll re-propose times.

Which option works best?

Thanks —

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: need quick alignment before I re-touch EdgeSight (POC timing unknown)

Team — looping you in briefly. Olivia and Jordan haven't replied to the bump. Before I send another outreach I want to align on an approach so we don't spam them and so SE/CS know the ask if they re-engage.

Context: discovery call 3/10 attached (edge-discovery-notes.pdf). POC target May but no firm commitment. Key asks we want to validate in a technical sync:
- network topology (VPC peering vs. private deployment)
- SOC2 evidence they require (we can share our readiness checklist)
- realistic latency target (they said <150ms at 95th but we should confirm sample payloads)

Ask to the group:
- Ava: can you be available for a 45m SE call if they confirm May? If not, what's earliest availability? Also flag any non-starters technically.
- Monica: how would CS support a May POC (onboarding tasks / success criteria to include)?
- Vivek: I'm happy to loop you in if we need escalation/discount approvals — any guardrails you want me to follow?

Plan: I will wait 48 hours for internal replies, then send a concise re-engagement with two slots and a clear single ask (confirm timing).

Thanks —
Nikhil

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: need quick alignment before I re-touch EdgeSight (POC timing unknown)

Nikhil —

I can cover the SE call the week of May 4 if we lock by April 10. Notes from my side:
- Private deployment: doable, but need sample payloads and expected concurrency to size KV cache and batch settings.
- SOC2: we'll provide our controls mapping; items to confirm from them: data flows where PHI could be present (if any) and retention specifics.
- Latency: 150ms 95th is achievable on A100s with optimized batching if average sequence length <512; if they have larger payloads we may need quantized variants or sharding.

Non-starter: if they require PII to leave their VPC under any circumstance, we should decline; otherwise good to proceed.

I can prepare a 1-page tech agenda for the sync (will attach).

- Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.ai
